problem.title: Viscous Burgers equation
problem.equation: \frac{\partial u}{\partial t} + u\,\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \nu\,\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}
problem.analytical_method: Cole-Hopf transform, integrals by trapezoid quadrature (2001 nodes)
problem.numerical_method: Fourier pseudo-spectral (2048 modes, 2/3 dealiasing) with ETDRK4, dt = 5e-4
